paired_block_validity.condition: BOTH AE and SE runs in pair must pass all applicable gates

notes: Abbreviated summaries are acceptable for human communication but must not replace the execution contract
Every formal experiment run must validate against the full gate set
SE provenance gates enforce exact canonical model artifact identity
